metadata.description: Live-captured POST /api/mdm/profiles/platforms/linux/update against UEM 26.2.0.0 (host <internal-env>), 2026-08-10, the recapture epic's Workstream C. Route absent from the vendored upstream swagger (no internal-source/*.json declares it) and gap-filled by internal-source/mdmv4.overlay.yaml, so internal-source/mdmv4.json declares /profiles/platforms/linux/update, captured directly against a profile created for the capture (see create-v4.json in this same directory) then deleted immediately after capture -- no leftovers on the tenant (confirmed via a follow-up search returning 204/empty for platform=Linux, org group 138883). Accept header application/json;version=4 per doctrine quirk 3 (Linux uses v4, all other platforms use v2). Request included General.CreateNewVersion=true and General.ProfileScope=1 (int; see create-v4.json note on the string-declared/int-actual swagger mismatch). Response is a 200 with a null/empty body, same shape as the appleosx/winrt update responses.
